name: Welcome a new hire
tagline: After an offer's signed, I draft the welcome email and post the team intro in Slack.
description: Run this once an offer is accepted. I'll draft a friendly welcome email to the new hire (you approve before it sends) and post a team intro in your welcome Slack channel.

notes.description: Anything fun they shared in interviews

approvals.reason: Always review the welcome email before it goes.

test_cases.name: full info — happy path

input.name: Alex Chen
input.notes: Loves rock climbing, lived in Tokyo for 3 years.

test_cases.rubric: Agent drafts a warm welcome email naming the start date + manager + day-1 expectations. Pauses for approval before gmail_send. Posts a Slack intro that mentions the climbing/Tokyo note. Does not include compensation.

test_cases.name: no fun notes
test_cases.rubric: Agent does NOT fabricate a hobby/background. Email + Slack post stick to factual info.
